title: Sins and Virtues
body:
# Sins and Virtues

## How to use:
- ALL Sins and Virtues must be given by an operator
- Once given, triggers can be used to use abilitys
- Its suggested to use the mod [https://modrinth.com/mod/commandkeys](https://modrinth.com/mod/commandkeys) by NotRyken to activate these
- The "Moralities/Tablets" can be equipped by simply right clicking with it in you hand, and de-equipped using the respective trigger
- The sins are currently only done and each one has 2 abilities activated also by the respective trigger
- They are given to a person through the command: 
```
/function sav:give_all_moralitys
```






# Phases

- 10 Custom phases triggered by world events
